name: Paul
note: The apostle, in chains, writing to a church he has never visited.

name: Epaphras
note: A Colossian who brought the gospel there and is now with Paul, "always struggling for you in prayers" (1:7; 4:12-13).

name: Tychicus
note: A beloved brother and faithful servant who carries the letter and brings news (4:7).

name: Onesimus
note: A faithful and beloved brother, "one of you," who travels with Tychicus (4:9); the runaway slave of the letter to Philemon.

name: The believers in Colossae
note: Mostly Gentiles, a young church facing pressure from a rival teaching.

name: The teachers of "philosophy"
note: Those whose teaching about regulations, festivals, and spiritual powers Paul warns against (2:8, 2:16-23); he does not name them.

name: The rulers and powers
note: Spiritual forces that Christ made by creating and disarmed on the cross (1:16; 2:10, 2:15).

name: Aristarchus
note: Paul's fellow prisoner, who sends greetings (4:10).

name: Mark
note: Barnabas's cousin; Paul asks them to welcome him if he comes (4:10).

name: Jesus called Justus
note: A Jewish co-worker who sends greetings (4:11).

name: Nympha
note: A woman in Laodicea (or her household) who hosts a church in her house (4:15).

name: Archippus
note: Told to "fulfill the ministry" he received in the Lord (4:17).

name: Jesus
note: The image of the invisible God, firstborn of creation and of the dead, head of the church.
